case_title: DOUGLAS, ROBERT J. VS GREYHOUND LINES INC.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY DOUGLAS, ROBERT J. AS TO DEFENDANT GREYHOUND LINES INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-31-2000 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DOUGLAS, ROBERT J. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GREYHOUND LINES INC. PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
